site_name: Viettel High-Tech Data Center and R&D Hub (Tan Phu Trung)
town: Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, Cu Chi
notes: Groundbreaking 23 Apr 2025; about 4 ha, about 10,000 racks; 140MW design power (IT vs total not stated). Billed as Vietnam's first 100MW+ data centre. The Investor (6 Nov 2025) reports operations from Q1 2026 and full completion before 2030; whether phase 1 is live by Nov 2026 not confirmed in sources opened, so left as Under construction. Capex not disclosed.

Inaugurated 10 Apr 2024; 30MW, more than 2,400 racks; Viettel's 14th data centre. Viettel network total then 87MW, 11,500 racks. Viettel planned VND10tn (US$401m) to reach 17,000 racks by 2025 and VND40tn for 34,000 racks by 2030.

Inaugurated 20 Aug 2025; 10,000 m2 over eight floors, 3,600 racks; FPT called it Vietnam's largest. FPT's fourth large DC (HN01, HN02, HCM01, HCM02; over 7,000 racks combined). MW and capex not disclosed. FPT is a private listed Vietnamese group (foreign shareholders not checked).
Saigon Hi-Tech Park board approved investment end-June 2025; over US$250m; starts at 30MW, expandable to 120MW (120 shown as full build). No operation date stated.

site_name: KBC-AIC AI data center (Tan Phu Trung)
operator: Kinh Bac City Development (KBC) with Accelerated Infrastructure Capital (AIC)
town: Tan Phu Trung Industrial Park, Cu Chi
notes: MoU signed 28 Oct 2025; about 10 ha; designed IT load up to 200MW, around 100,000 GPUs; nearly US$2bn from equity and loans. No timeline. MoU stage only.

site_name: STT VNG Ho Chi Minh City 1
operator: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC) and VNG
town: Tan Thuan Export Processing Zone, District 7
notes: 9.6MW IT, Uptime Tier III. Opening year not stated in source opened. VNG described as Tencent-invested; stake size not given, so Chinese capital link is indirect.

site_name: STT VNG Ho Chi Minh City 2
operator: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC) and VNG
town: Tan Thuan Export Processing Zone, District 7
notes: JV formed 15 May 2024; up to 60MW IT potential; about 1.5 km from HCM1; targeted H1 2026 operation. Whether it opened not confirmed in sources opened. Status inferred.

site_name: G42-FPT-VinaCapital-Viet Thai hyperscale AI data center
operator: G42 with FPT and Viet Thai Group
owner_investors: G42; FPT; VinaCapital; Viet Thai Group
notes: Proposal to PM Pham Minh Chinh reported Jul 2025 (Reuters also reported): US$2bn AI factory. G42 shareholders include a UAE sovereign fund and Microsoft. Framework agreement signed 9 Feb 2026 by FPT/Viet Thai consortium and G42 with consumption commitments up to US$1bn (theinvestor.vn d18355); no MW, site or timeline.
